pages.text: God's people were afraid of their enemies, who took their food. An angel found Gideon hiding and said, "God is with you, brave man!"
Gideon asked God for a sign. He laid out a woolly fleece, and in the morning only the fleece was wet. God answered, and Gideon believed.
God said, "You have too many soldiers." Only three hundred men stayed. God wanted everyone to know that He is the One who saves.
At night the three hundred men blew trumpets and held up torches hidden in clay jars. The enemy ran away! God had saved His people.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Gideon felt small, but God did great things through him. God can use anyone who trusts Him.

pages.text: An angel told a mother and father they would have a special baby boy named Samson. He would belong to God, and his hair would never be cut.
Samson grew up with amazing strength from God. Once, he even beat a lion with his bare hands!
Samson's enemies wanted to know the secret of his strength. A woman named Delilah kept asking, until Samson told her about his hair.
While Samson slept, his hair was cut, and his strength left him. His enemies captured him. Samson was sad, because he had forgotten God's gift.
In prison, Samson's hair grew back. He prayed, "God, please make me strong again." God heard him and gave him strength to help his people.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Samson's strength was a gift from God. God hears us when we pray, even after we make mistakes.
